source_review.notes: Checked current primary Linux kernel documentation for TLB flushing and page tables; current RISC-V supervisor, hypervisor, and SBI remote-fence specifications; current Intel and Arm architecture documentation; the Linux performance-event man-page; and MIT's 2025 xv6 text. All nine cited URLs returned HTTP 200 after normal redirects; architecture, OS, implementation, empirical, and assurance claims are distinguished.

notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation separates entry matching, nominal capacity, workload-conditioned reach, address-space identity, and distributed invalidation completion.

evidence: Executed 64 base-page entries at 4 KiB and confirmed 256 KiB nominal base reach.
Executed four 2 MiB entries and confirmed 8 MiB huge reach, 8.25 MiB combined reach, and 512 base pages per huge page.
numerical_recomputation.notes: The deterministic model omits associativity, partitions, conflicts, replacement, page walks, faults, invalidation, and workload locality.
